title: Lolly Willowes

sensory: a quiet pact with the devil
vibeProfile.oneLine: An overlooked aunt escapes her family, moves to the country, and turns witch.

summary: A dutiful unmarried aunt, long taken for granted by her family, abruptly moves to a country village on her own, discovers an unexpected freedom, and quietly becomes a witch. Sylvia Townsend Warner's droll, subversive first novel turns a spinster's rebellion into a sly feminist fable about a woman claiming a life, and a self, entirely her own. Charming and strange in equal measure, it has been rediscovered as a small classic of female independence with a wicked supernatural twist.
whyReadIt: A spinster claims her freedom by becoming a witch. A sly, charming feminist fable, rightly rediscovered.

funFacts.text: It was the first book ever chosen by the American Book of the Month Club, in 1926.
